text: Climate change is honestly one of the biggest problems we've got right now, and it touches basically everything: farming, health, you name it. There's no single fix, but a few things help. Cutting carbon emissions by switching to renewable energy is a big one. So is protecting forests and wetlands, since that keeps ecosystems intact instead of making things worse. And yeah, what one person does barely matters alone, but it adds up when enough people actually do it.
